title: The Library
description: My very first  web application that allows users to search for books within the warhammer 40k universe. It features a user-friendly interfce and many tools, such as book rating, summaries and quote saving.

title: The Wild Oasis
description: A complete rewrite of my first web application, The Library. This version is built with Next.js and TypeScript, and features a more modern design and improved performance.
